title: Drop Computation Correctness
statement: For every mode $m\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and every input bit string $h$, the specified computation started in its length-test state with all nine registers zero and no answer halts with the membership indicator of the mode-$m$ drop language on $h$. Every configuration before halting satisfies the stated computation invariant.
